usedFor: Apex27 holds listings, leads and contacts, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers after “New Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Apex27, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new lead is the moment worth reacting to, and the action runs a command on your own computers.

watchOut: “New Lead” is polling, so the command on your computers starts after a scheduled check.
